title: Letting a conversation reach its end

captions.physics: Developing what is said through details
captions.energy: Bringing the exchange to a whole
captions.emotions: Feeling attached to a desired agreement

meaning: You can seek a complete meaning in conversation, while a strong attachment to desired agreement can make an answer already heard difficult to accept.
text: A full conversation does not always produce the answer you deeply wanted. The Empress in the physical position of Vishuddha helps a suggestion unfold: discussing details, giving an example and making a wish understandable. The World in energy supports a constructive wish to bring the words into a whole and end the exchange with clear meaning. The Devil in emotions shows a clinging expectation. Even after a detailed reply, hope for a different agreement is difficult to release. Conversation can reach an honest conclusion while feelings continue bargaining with it.

For example, you discuss a request to attend a gathering together. Every detail has been named and the answer is clear, yet another argument seems likely to change it. **A complete conversation leaves room for an unwished answer.** You can hear the actual decision and acknowledge disappointment. The shared story keeps clear outlines: a request was voiced, understood and answered personally, with feelings still needing time.

The difficulty is presenting repeated persuasion as a need to “discuss everything properly”. Conversation begins again although the only missing detail is a different reply. The wish for wholeness stays good. Distinguishing a question left unclear from an answer left unaccepted keeps words honest and participation free, giving even an imperfect outcome room to stand.
